name: Common Room
description: Common Room is a customer-intelligence platform that unifies product, community, social, CRM, and intent signals into contact and organization profiles. Go-to-market teams use it to identify, segment, research, and engage accounts and people from one workspace.
agentUseSummary: Enter a room-admin API token from the customer's own Common Room workspace, select workspace reads or API v2 authority, and choose Safe or Dangerously skip permissions for each agent install.

credentialRequirements.name: COMMON_ROOM_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Common Room API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: A room admin creates a token in Common Room Settings > API tokens. Railway stores it encrypted and attaches it only to fixed-origin api.commonroom.io requests.

capabilities.label: Read workspace metadata
capabilities.description: Validate the token and list bounded segment and visible signal-provider metadata.

capabilities.label: Common Room API v2
capabilities.description: Use the complete documented API v2 surface authorized by the customer's room-admin token.

allowed.label: Validate room token
allowed.description: Validate the connected room-admin API token without exposing it.

allowed.label: List segments
allowed.description: List one bounded page of segment summaries.

allowed.label: List signal providers
allowed.description: List one bounded page of visible signal-provider summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Use documented API v2
approvalRequired.description: Call one bounded documented Common Room API v2 operation; Safe mode requires approval for every call outside the three pinned reads.

blocked.label: Export private people data
blocked.description: Bulk contact, organization, activity, website-visit, enrichment, email, social-profile, and custom-field exports are not mounted as direct tools.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary endpoints
blocked.description: Caller-selected origins, v1 ingestion, SCIM, RTBF, private endpoints, browser automation, and undocumented paths are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Pinned workspace-metadata reads run directly; every other documented API v2 operation requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected token-authorized API v2 operation runs without Relay per-action approval while fixed origin, credential secrecy, request bounds, audits, provider authority, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected Common Room tools and injects the encrypted room token server-side.
Railway mounts selected Common Room tools and injects the encrypted room token server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: A room admin creates a least-privilege API token in the customer's Common Room instance, enters it in Relay, and validates the selected room, plan, role, data-governance, and rate limits before installing it on agents.

evidence.supports: Common Room publishes a fixed-origin API v2 for contact, organization, activity, segment, tag, provider, location, topic, custom-object and related read/write resources, with bounded pagination and 400/403/404/429 responses.
Common Room documents customer-created API tokens and member, activity, lookup, and right-to-be-forgotten uses.
Common Room presents its API as the supported developer surface for creating and updating members, adding activity, retrieving member information, and anonymizing personal data.

Common Room also publishes an OAuth 2.1 hosted MCP surface with read and write tools; Relay does not mount its raw dynamic tool list and instead pins typed fixed-origin REST wrappers until the exact provider-hosted OAuth distribution lifecycle is accepted.
